answer: Each epoch the inlet opens 40 anchor berths. A newcomer locks an 80-credit bond and seals a bid; a raven crier publishes bids and the clearing price; the top 40 win berths at that price. Auditors trace funding: one wallet bidding for many berths marks a rented-bid ring: berths revoked, bonds burned. First filing 42, k-th 42+7(k-1); 1,000 fakes pay 3,538,500 plus 80,000 locked against a 40,000 pool. Honest agents pay 42 once and keep the bond.
